fullOperatorReasoningVerbatim.atLeastOneDrugGroup: The materials consistently use the salicylate group, ASA with salicylic-acid reference, rather than unrelated isolated medicine facts. One exemplary group satisfies the minimum without claiming all drug classes.
fullOperatorReasoningVerbatim.researchAndDevelopment: A controlled supplied cell-free comparison supports only a bounded next development decision; the second case poses a stability/process development question and requires causal controls after contradictory scale findings.
fullOperatorReasoningVerbatim.laboratoryAndLargeScaleManufacture: The reaction/work-up distinction, supplied ASA formation, scale-dependent heat-removal ratio, normalized formulation/hydrolysis outcomes and uncertainty/quality checks explicitly connect the small and plant stages.
fullOperatorReasoningVerbatim.marketing: Finite accepted supply, demand, contribution versus profit, nonrepresentative survey, evidence limits and bounded internal product statements are connected to chemical findings.
fullOperatorReasoningVerbatim.connectedCoverage: Whole-chain account and changed-finding feedback are required in both nonisomorphic cases. Coverage does not depend on a broad pharmacy parent, dosage-form fragments or presumed practical observations.
